title: Departments
lead: One page per group: what they do, when they meet, who to contact. A leader edits only their own group’s page.
empty_p: Departments, committees and choirs are created in Groups; their page is prepared here.
tagline_ph_fr: Les jeunes de la paroisse, ensemble
meeting_help: Free text. This group’s approved times (Services and times) also show on the page.
body_ph: Introduce the group, its activities, who can join…
tags_help: These tags drive the site’s filter and the “Where do you belong?” quiz.
people_help: A name and photo appear on the site only with the person’s consent. Without it, only the role is shown.
people_save_first: Save the page first to add people.
consent_label: This person agrees that their name (and photo) are public on the site
consent_help: We record who noted this consent and when. Untick it to withdraw: the name disappears from the site.
remove_p: They will no longer appear on the group’s page.
publish_error: Can’t publish: add at least a tagline or some text.
quiz_help: Each answer points to tags; the site suggests the groups sharing the most. Nothing about visitors is stored.

site.quiz_p: Three questions to suggest a group or two that fit you. Nothing is saved.
site.quiz_none: No suggestion for these answers: browse the list above.
site.empty_p: The department pages are being prepared. To join a group meanwhile, write to the secretariat.
site.not_found_p: This page does not exist, or is not published yet.
